title: The Dogon's knowledge of the Sirius binary star system

tellings.quote: And they they somehow, you know, in their tradition knew that there were two Sirius planets, Sirius A and Sirius B.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, citing Robert Temple's book The Sirius Mystery, says the Dogon people of Mali somehow knew, through their own traditions, that Sirius, a bright point in the night sky, is really two bodies, which he calls Sirius A and Sirius B. The point of the story is that such knowledge would be hard to explain unless it came from somewhere outside.
